conditions.COMMON_AUTHORITY: Required in authority repo in both modes; accepted existing equivalent may be mapped except fixed EP declaration
conditions.COMMON_REPOSITORY: Required in every attached repository in both modes
conditions.SELECTED_BASELINE: Exact finite assets from the chosen qualified locally installed baseline
conditions.POSIX_VALIDATION: Selected stack/host uses the supported POSIX validation wrapper
conditions.MANAGED_GITHUB: Selected Managed repository host is GitHub
conditions.SECURITY_PROFILE: MANAGED_GITHUB and selected supported security profile requires workflow; Genesis local security checks remain independent
conditions.CODEQL_PROFILE: MANAGED_GITHUB and host, language and project policy support and require CodeQL
conditions.OWNERSHIP_PROFILE: MANAGED_GITHUB and explicit approved ownership policy requires CODEOWNERS
conditions.DEPENDENCY_PROFILE: MANAGED_GITHUB and supported dependency-management profile selected
conditions.EXPLICIT_LICENSE: Owner explicitly selected license and copyright holder
conditions.EXPLICIT_STACK_TEMPLATE: Finite approved stack template chosen; no automatic feature generation

digest_rule: Canonical UTF-8 JSON; exclude declared digest field; no recursive self-content hash. Execution result separately binds full tree and commit.

entries.content: Existing supported EP schema; project/repository/authority IDs and actual validation declaration; no new unknown fields
References to EP logical IDs, product artifact map, document language and profile/context references; no second identity authority
Pinned baseline, applicable profiles, DoR/DoD/gates, overlays, exceptions and authority-project contract reference for children
Exact installed baseline versions, component hashes, compatibility and license/redistribution provenance
Approved normalized artifact inventory and operation/plan binding; no recursive self-hash or fabricated result
Mode-specific desired state, supported host requirements and explicit exceptions; not actual compliance evidence
Finite selected portable schemas/contract/validator assets; no template path traversal or source-runtime imports
Product/repository purpose, actual quickstart, role and links; no invented implemented features
Thin route to project authority, applicable local baseline and validation; no hardcoded pcvantol paths
Thin agent guidance over governed contract, target bounds and existing owner decisions
Narrow stack-specific build/runtime/secret exclusions; never hide required portable engineering artifacts
Explicit portable text/binary rules without rewriting existing file contents during adoption
Purpose/users/value/outcomes/non-goals/constraints/assumptions and unresolved questions with provenance
Boundaries/components/interfaces/data/security/technology rationale and pending decisions, not invented approval
ADR convention; actual decision records added only when a real decision exists
Approved direction plus clearly separated proposals; no fake completed capability or Mission
Stable capability/edge IDs and approved source digest; not the Living Mission Graph or execution authority
Actual supported commands, profiles, proofs and missing-tool behavior; no always-green stub
Source/as-of-bound navigation and unresolved work; not operational runtime state
Qualified baseline wrapper for selected local validations; non-POSIX equivalent resolved explicitly
Selected actual validator checks, pinned dependencies and least workflow permissions
Applicable supported security checks; requirements based on capability profile
Only supported languages/host capability; no unavailable feature labelled PASS
Explicitly selected valid owners; no template-maintainer or current assistant as fabricated approver
Scope/candidate/validation/review/evidence prompts; not approval evidence
Supported selected ecosystems/cadence; does not auto-approve dependency PRs
Explicit selected license text/holder, no automatic legal choice
Finite build/test/scaffold files and dependency locks approved in concrete plan, no paid providers or feature Mission

child_rule: Child repositories retain their own common repository artifacts and reference authority-owned product/roadmap documents; do not duplicate product authority.
genesis_rule: No remote effects or automatic GitHub assets; remote-only requirements explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE_GENESIS.
managed_rule: Host assets selected by provider/profile and actual governance readback mandatory before Managed readiness.
